headline: Esmaeil Baghaei: We will certainly not tolerate these actions and will use all available means to
label: QUOTE
quote: We will certainly not tolerate these actions and will use all available means to counter US aggression
speaker: Esmaeil Baghaei
title: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson
caption:
Iran is sending a clear warning to Washington. 🇮🇷

Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei made the remarks at his weekly news conference in Tehran on Monday, Al Jazeera reported, citing AFP and Reuters.

He described US sanctions and the economic and naval blockade on Iran as an act of military aggression, and said the Strait of Hormuz could reopen within two days if Washington halts hostilities, lifts the blockade and waives sanctions.
